correctness_requirement: Do not run unless NPU engine decision LoRA, text, image and batch-parity gates pass

inputs.adaptation: Counting questions converted from open-ended to 4-option Choice; distractors sampled from integers 0–30 and Not Applicable; not official CharXiv score or Decision Index reproduction.
inputs.ablation: Run same questions with images and without images; separate accuracy and calibration, fixed original question text.
inputs.images: Original public charts, longest edge <=1024, no cropping

inputs.protocol: First 64 eligible first-900px viewport cases; one positive plus seven sampled visible interactive negatives; numbered screenshot + element text and prior actions.
inputs.exclusions: Target not visible in first viewport, fewer than seven visible interactive negatives, missing screenshot.
inputs.limitations: Oracle candidate inclusion; adapted element-selection accuracy, not official step success or full agent task success. No model outputs used in sampling.

execution: 4 threads, image and no-image per question; capability-only, no performance conclusions from replay timings
gold: Strict choice_index equality; failed/invalid calls counted as wrong; retain all responses and failures
text_protocol_clarifications: Source Score tasks have 4 or 5 levels, explicitly mapped to Choice with original descriptions.
20-option MASSIVE uses upstream wide-label extension beyond 16 trained Choice labels; separate interpretation.
